conditioning: sentences: within-document boundary F1 (a document's final sentence end is never a boundary) on form-aligned tokens for CoNLL-U predictions; in per-document space-joined # text coordinates for sentence tiers
fields: gold denominators; gold and predicted token streams aligned by form with bounded resync; an unaligned gold token scores zero on every field; gold sentences containing one are counted
bootstrap: per-document pooled resampling for token-aligned metrics

tokens (tokenizer tiers): UAX #29 segments of the per-document space-joined # text with whitespace-only segments dropped, or Unicode White_Space runs for the whitespace baseline; no gold segmentation reaches a tier

not_run: sentences/fields: a tokenizer tier writes no sentence or field predictions
sentences/fields: a tokenizer tier writes no sentence or field predictions
